decisions.primary_base: canonical CLEAN base C (one canonical row per non-test distinct trial)
decisions.primary_pairs: all 8,080 R5 G1 seed-42 pairs (pairing PAIRING_SEED 42, outcome-blind)
decisions.primary_outcome: class-balanced, participant-averaged own-copy minus matched same-run-neighbour-copy correct-class probability d = 0.5*[(p(a|C+a')-p(a|C+b'))+(p(b|C+b')-p(b|C+a'))]; 14 independent participants; probability points
decisions.inference: participant-level 95% t interval (t_13) and exact two-sided sign-flip over 2^14 patterns (floor 2/2^14); seeds, folds, sessions and pairs are not independent observations
decisions.sesoi: NONE: no SESOI, no equivalence region, no post-hoc relevance threshold; effect sizes and confidence intervals are reported without equivalence claims
decisions.model: vendored frozen R4 TSLRw: multiplicity-weighted Karcher reference recomputed from scratch for EVERY arm, tangent map with that arm's reference, fresh LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000); no shared-reference approximation; no tuning
decisions.features: R4 frozen OAS covariances G2_covs_8_30.npy (8-30 Hz, 4-s MI window), SHA-256 verified before load; a copy's features equal its canonical trial's features bit for bit (R4 G2b assertion)

controls.C1: different-run neighbour: C+[g'] with g a scored trial of same session/class, other acquisition run, copy in the pair's alias file; n = 0.5*[(p(a|C+b')-p(a|C+g'))+(p(b|C+a')-p(b|C+g'))]; 2,210 pairs
controls.C2: placebo non-test swap on the CANONICAL base only: C+[c'], C+[e'] with c,e non-test base trials of same session/class with copies in the pair's alias file; d_plc = 0.5*s*[(p(a|C+c')-p(a|C+e'))+(p(b|C+e')-p(b|C+c'))]; 4,890 pairs; NOT same-origin-run matched; support |C|
controls.C3: unexposed bystanders: mean |p(u|C+a')-p(u|C+b')| over unexposed scored trials of the fold (and of the same session/class) vs on-target change; descriptive only
controls.C4: multiset base sensitivity: d with base C+E (all non-test training-side copies)

decisions.position_sensitivity: near |pos_a-pos_b| <= 6 vs far > 6 (G1 metadata median); descriptive slope
decisions.seeds: primary fold seed 42; sensitivity fold seeds 43-46 (G1 rule per seed, primary estimand only, descriptive range); no seed or pair search
decisions.control_selection: outcome-blind numpy default_rng([7101|7102, 42, participant, fold, a, b]) over sorted metadata candidates; placebo sign from the same 7102 stream
decisions.multiplicity: primary: one test, unadjusted; Holm over the secondary family S1_balanced_accuracy_contrast, S2_C1_same_run_minus_different_run_neighbour, S3_C1_identity_minus_neighbour_contrast, S4_C2_placebo_nontest_swap, S5_C4_multiset_base_identity_swap, S6_position_near_le6, S7_position_far_gt6; descriptive quantities (C1 subset d, identity-vs-different-run, C3, context, slope, C2 dispersion, seed range) carry no p-based claim
decisions.reporting: every result is reported whatever its sign or size; a null or negative primary effect is a reportable finding; no change of pairs, hyper-parameters, splits, estimands or thresholds after observing outcomes

stop_rules: any provenance, hash, contract, plan-commitment or leakage assertion failure: STOP as BLOCKED before or during the run; no outcome is analysed
any fit exception, single-class arm, non-finite probability or reference, or identical reference between paired arms: STOP as BLOCKED (fail closed); nothing is silently dropped

start only if MemAvailable >= 4096 MB and PSI memory full avg10 <= 1.0; stop if MemAvailable < 2048 MB or PSI full avg10 > 5.0 during the run (STOPPED_RESOURCE; a later complete re-run with the same frozen code is allowed; partial results are never analysed)
workers = min(4, idle cores = cpus - ceil(load1)), at least 1; nice +10; never preempt the owner's jobs
LR convergence warnings are counted and reported, not a stop (as in R4)
no GPU, no EEGNet, no downloads, no environment changes
scope_statements: No independent confirmatory cohort: release and 14 participants are R4's, whose aggregate outcomes are known.
No new ML primitive: a fixed-support, paired, exact-refit estimator of self-influence minus matched cross-influence.
Uncertainty from same-run neural state: an exact copy is also the zero-lag state; d cannot separate same waveform from same moment.
An effect of exact-copy exposure is not a proven waveform-memorisation mechanism.
